habits.title: Establish a 45-Minute Screen-Free Wind-Down Buffer
habits.desc: Blue light suppresses natural melatonin release. Put devices away 45 minutes before sleep and switch to reading, gentle stretching, or relaxing music.

habits.title: Anchor a Consistent Wake Time
habits.desc: Waking up at the same hour each morning (within 30 minutes) reinforces circadian stability and daytime alertness.

habits.title: Create a Dark, Quiet & Cool Sleep Sanctuary
habits.desc: Lower bedroom temperature and block ambient light to facilitate deeper slow-wave restorative sleep.

habits.title: 25-Minute Phone-Free Pomodoro Study Block
habits.desc: Place your phone in a bag or across the room. Study for 25 focused minutes, followed by a 5-minute cognitive rest.

habits.title: Mute or Unfollow Upward-Comparison Accounts
habits.desc: Audit your social media feeds. Mute profiles or topics that trigger comparison, inadequacy, or anxiety.

habits.title: Batch Social Notifications into Designated Windows
habits.desc: Check social apps twice daily rather than interrupting study flows for every ding or ping.

habits.title: Deconstruct Large Coursework into Micro-Tasks
habits.desc: Break daunting assignments into 3 bite-sized steps (e.g. outline first, draft next) to eliminate overwhelm.

habits.title: Utilize Peer Study Groups or Faculty Office Hours
habits.desc: Clarify challenging concepts early with mentors or classmates rather than struggling in solitary isolation.

habits.title: Take Genuine Rest Breaks (Zero Coursework Reflection)
habits.desc: Allow your brain to consolidate learning by stepping away from study materials during meal and rest times.

habits.title: 20-Minute Morning Walk in Natural Sunlight
habits.desc: Morning outdoor photons stimulate cortisol awakening response and synchronize evening melatonin onset.

habits.title: 5-Minute Desk Decompression Stretches
habits.desc: Release neck, shoulder, and spinal tension caused by prolonged laptop posture.

habits.title: Stay Consciously Hydrated Throughout Study Sessions
habits.desc: Even 2% dehydration impairs working memory and elevates subjective fatigue.

habits.title: Schedule a 15-Minute Coffee or Walk with a Classmate
habits.desc: Brief, genuine peer interactions alleviate loneliness and provide mutual perspective during stressful terms.

habits.title: Explore a University Hobby or Interest Club
habits.desc: Connecting with students outside your immediate academic discipline builds a broader campus support network.
